Quality indicators within the Danish healthcare system are essential metrics used to monitor and ensure the standard of clinical practices, particularly in the assessment and treatment of ADHD. The [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] utilizes these indicators to track the timeliness and thoroughness of diagnostic pathways across different pediatric age groups, ensuring that national clinical guidelines are met and that patients receive timely care.

For older children and adolescents, specific metrics track the speed and method of diagnosis. According to [[indicator-2b]], "Indikator 2b" measures the proportion of diagnostic pathways for patients aged 6 to 17 where a manualized diagnostic interview or environmental observation is conducted no later than 120 days after the initiation of the ADHD assessment [^src1]. Similarly, for preschool-aged children, "Indikator 2a" tracks the proportion of cases for 0- to 5-year-olds where the child is assessed via clinical environmental observation within that same 120-day window [^src2]. These indicators highlight the systemic emphasis on timely, observation-based diagnostic practices for youth.

Beyond the diagnostic phase, quality indicators also monitor prevailing treatment modalities. Data associated with [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] reveals that medical treatment is the most frequently offered treatment modality within hospital-based psychiatry [^src3]. Together, these metrics provide a comprehensive overview of both diagnostic efficiency and the primary treatment approaches utilized in the public psychiatric system.

## Claims
- Indikator 2b: Andelen af udredningsforløb blandt 6-17 årige, hvor der, senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning, er foretaget enten manualiseret diagnostisk interview eller miljøobservation [^src1] (adhd-databasen, indicator-2b)
  Type: quality-indicator
  Page: 16
  Source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2023.pdf, pages 16-20
- Indikator 2a: Andelen af udredningsforløb blandt 0-5 årige, hvor barnet er vurderet ved klinisk miljøobservation senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning [^src1] (adhd-databasen)
  Type: clinical-practice
  Page: 11
  Source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2023.pdf, pages 11-15
- Medicinsk behandling er den hyppigste behandlingsmodalitet som tilbydes i den hospitalsbaserede psykiatri[^src1]. (indikator-11)
  Type: clinical-practice
  Page: 56
  Source: wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2024.pdf, pages 56-60
